name: decode
description: a reader takes only the exact canonical bytes (a bucket length, space padding, sorted keys, no whitespace, the writer's escapes, integers 0..2^53 - 1, a string `type` and an integer `v`), and the `branch` type v 1 only with its six fields, a blind that checks against a non-null head, packs sorted and distinct, at least one, lowercase hex of the right widths, a refs/heads/ name with no control character, and the salt's check-name key. Another type reads as a letter but not as a branch.
